Criterion: Verify that each aerial refueling system, in the open/deployed position and in the closed/retracted position, is designed to withstand the appropriate lightning strike criteria. Standard: Each aerial refueling system, in the open/deployed position and in the closed/retracted position, is designed to withstand lightning strikes without causing damage to air vehicle as appropriate, loss of air vehicle, or creating hazards to personnel. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, inspection and review of documentation. Analysis of design, inspection of drawings, and laboratory tests verify each aerial refueling system, in the open/deployed position and in the closed/retracted position, is designed to withstand lightning strikes without causing damage to air vehicle or creating hazards to personnel. References: JSSG-2001: 3.2.1, 3.3.10.1.1 JSSG-2009: G.3.4.7.6, G.4.4.7.6 14 CFR 23.954, 25.954
